end.summary:
Recognised halves, thirds and quarters using equal parts of a whole.
Found fractions of collections by dividing into equal groups.
Compared 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 of the same whole.
Initially described a fraction as parts taken compared with parts left; corrected this to parts out of the whole by turn 2.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised equal shares, naming fractions, finding fractions of collections, and comparing unit fractions. Nisha used equal grouping and division to find answers, including 1/2 of 24, 1/4 of 24, 1/3 of 9, and the difference between 1/3 and 1/4 of 12. They first mixed up a fraction with parts taken compared with parts left, then corrected it by referring to all parts in the whole. At home, use paper or fruit cut into equal pieces and ask Nisha to name one piece as a fraction of the whole.
